backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality with product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding/homepage configuration, Stripe integration, order management, and admin access control; includes migration support and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old product and cart data structures to new versions by adding a displayOrder field (defaulting to product ID) to products and updating nested cart items accordingly.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three features: fixing Add to Cart errors with authentication handling, creating a product display order mutation hook, and implementing drag-and-drop product reordering in the admin table.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components, pages, and hooks including marketplace, dashboard, checkout flow, product management, branding configuration, and authentication features with AUD pricing and guest checkout support.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space for background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, title 'Original Creations Hub', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment success/failure, terms, and privacy; includes ThemeProvider, Toaster, and dynamic branding hook.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and form submission using useUpdateBrandingConfig mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, supporting auto-copy of fields across products, description templates, and progress tracking during upload.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing reusable product description templates with name and content fields.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with options to create, edit, and delete templates.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site information, legal links (terms/privacy), contact details, and attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings component for customizing homepage hero section including motto, promotional text, and hero image upload.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header navigation, authentication controls, cart icon with item count, mobile menu, and admin dashboard link for authorized users.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Cart' button. Handles authentication checks and cart mutations with loading states.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product information with image, description, and actions for 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now'. Navigates to checkout for immediate purchase.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for managing products with inline editing, image uploads with progress tracking, inventory adjustments, shape filtering, and bulk update operations with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that previously showed a profile setup modal after login. Currently returns null and is not functional.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form for managing shop information including name, contact details, address, opening hours, and company details with validation and update functionality.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Configuration interface for Stripe payment integration allowing users to set secret key, allowed countries, and delete existing configuration with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages backend actor instances based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that fetches branding configuration and dynamically updates document title and favicon based on the retrieved settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, products, cart management, orders, Stripe configuration, branding, and admin functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for both light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the app with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays order summary, handles both cart and buy-now flows, and creates Stripe checkout sessions for payment processing.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates, restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page with hero section, product filtering by search/shape/category, sorting options (most viewed, best selling, newest), and product detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Displays a payment failure page with an error icon and buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Shows a payment success confirmation page, clears the cart and buyNowProductId from session storage on mount, and provides a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders a static privacy policy page with sections covering data collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, cookies, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with product items, quantity controls, remove functionality, and a checkout button with total price calculation.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders a static terms and conditions page covering products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, liability, and contact information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, typography plugin, container queries, animations, and custom font families (Inter and Crimson Pro).
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an Artisan Hub marketplace application with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, and Stripe payment processing. Currently has known issues with image persistence in bulk upload, marketplace image loading, and Add to Cart functionality.
